text:
Harper: quick sync  we need a clear call on the "first-impression" pattern for onboarding: top rail (persistent), banner (dismissible), or modal (interruptive)? Im pushing for a lightweight rail so we don't block flows.
Noah: rail 👍. Banners are easy to miss and modals feel like a blocker. Rail is discoverable but lower friction.
Jules: data from last test: banners had ~8% CTR, small rails ~18%. People like being able to peek without losing context.
Keiko: dev constraints: rail needs responsive collapse on mobile, and header spacing adjustments. estimate 2-3 dev days for MVP (compact chips), + 1 for responsive + a11y pass.
Lina: accessibility: if we do rail make sure there's a "skip to main" anchor, aria-live announcement only on first visit, focusable chip buttons, and clear focus styles. Also text over thumbnails needs contrast >= AA.
Harper: good. What about copy? Options: A) "Try a quick starter" B) "Starter projects" C) "Get started with a sample" Thoughts?
Noah: A is more action oriented. "Try a quick starter" + subcopy "Run one in under 5 minutes"
Jules: agree A. Microcopy for chip CTA: "Run" not "Open". Less friction.
Keiko: implementation plan: route param linking like /projects/:id?starter=vector to avoid adding onboarding state. minimal and stateless.
Keiko: example snippet:
```
// route param link
<Link to={`/projects/${p.id}?starter=${sample.slug}`}>Run</Link>
```
Lina: keyboard behavior: chips should be in tab order, arrow-key navigable (optional), pressing Enter launches sample and returns focus appropriately after sample finishes. Announce start via aria-live region when user triggers a sample.
Harper: analytics events we need: rail_impression, rail_expand, starter_initiated, starter_completed, rail_dismissed. Jules can own funnel.
Jules: will add events and a tiny retention pulse for new signups (D1 and D7).
Noah: visual variants for design handoff: 1) compact chip rail (MVP), 2) thumbnail strip with 3-up cards, 3) collapsed single-line summary. We should A/B 1 vs 2 for new signups.
Harper: timeline: aim for MVP next sprint. Keiko is that still 2-3 days?
Keiko: yes for compact chips + route param + analytics hook. skip fancy thumbnails for follow-up.
onboard-bot: Reminder: upload Figma link + tokens for handoff by Thursday EOD.
Harper: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/onboard-rail — includes token table and states.
Lina: I'll add a small a11y checklist to PR template and run a keyboard + NVDA pass once PR is up.
Jules: drafting events and test plan today, will post in this thread.
Keiko: starting feature branch now, will ping on initial PR.
Harper: final call: ship compact rail for first-run, collapsed for returning users, stateless route param to launch samples, instrument events, run a11y checks. Follow-up A/B with thumbnails. Moving this to sprint board. :rocket:
